title: Cosmic Androids in Desert
description: A surreal scene featuring two floating robotic female figures with cracked porcelain and metallic heads against a swirling cosmic sky. One has green skin and hair, the other red; both are surrounded by floating pancakes and ancient symbols above a cracked orange desert landscape with a glowing spiral sun on the horizon.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with two ethereal robotic female figures floating in a swirling galaxy sky. One has green patterned skin and flowing green hair, the other has red skin and long red hair. Both have cracked porcelain heads with gold filigree and mechanical bodies. They are surrounded by floating pancakes, ancient symbols and ornate keys. Below them is a barren cracked orange desert with a winding path leading to a glowing orange spiral sun on the horizon, dramatic swirling clouds and stars in the sky.
